items.text: And Yahuchanon bore witness, saying,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-kah-nohn bore witness, saying,

items.name: yahuchanon
items.text: “I have seen the Ruach coming down from shamayim like a dove and remain on Him. “And I did not know Him, but He who sent me to immerse in water said to me, ‘Upon whom you see the Ruach coming down and remaining on Him, this is He who immerses in the Ruach HaQadash.’ “And I have seen and have witnessed that this is the Son of Aluahim.”
items.kk: I have seen the roo-ahk coming down from shah-mah-yeem like a dove and remain on Him. And I did not know Him, but He who sent me to immerse in water said to me, Upon whom you see the roo-ahk coming down and remaining on Him, this is He who immerses in the roo-ahk hah-kah-dahsh. And I have seen and have witnessed that this is the Son of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The following day. Bĕyth Anyah beyond the Yardĕn
items.kk: The following day. bayt ahn-yah beyond the yar-den

items.name: narrator
items.text: Again the following day, Yahuchanon was standing with two of his taught ones,
items.kk: Again the following day, yah-hoo-kah-nohn was standing with two of his taught ones,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and looking at Yahusha walking, he said,
items.kk: and looking at yah-hoo-shah walking, he said,

items.name: yahuchanon
items.text: “See the Lamb of Aluahim!”
items.kk: See the Lamb of al-oo-ah-heem!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the two taught ones heard him speaking and they followed Yahusha.
items.kk: And the two taught ones heard him speaking and they followed yah-hoo-shah.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha turning, and seeing them following, said to them,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah turning, and seeing them following, said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What do you seek?”
items.kk: What do you seek?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they said to Him,
items.kk: And they said to Him,

items.name: two taught ones
items.text: “Rabbi”
items.kk: Rabbi

items.name: two taught ones
items.text: “where are You staying?”
items.kk: where are You staying?

items.name: narrator
items.text: He said to them,
items.kk: He said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Come and see.”
items.kk: Come and see.

items.name: narrator
items.text: They went and saw where He was staying, and remained with Him that day. Now it was about the tenth hour.
items.kk: They went and saw where He was staying, and remained with Him that day. Now it was about the tenth hour.

items.name: narrator
items.text: No one sends you away. You walk behind the three of them up from the river, the scroll under your arm.
items.kk: No one sends you away. You walk behind the three of them up from the river, the scroll under your arm.

items.name: narrator
items.text: You keep a few paces back, as a stranger would. When they turn off the road, you turn too.
items.kk: You keep a few paces back, as a stranger would. When they turn off the road, you turn too.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Andri, the brother of Shim‛on Kĕpha, was one of the two who heard from Yahuchanon, and followed Him.
items.kk: ahn-dree, the brother of sheem-ohn kay-fah, was one of the two who heard from yah-hoo-kah-nohn, and followed Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: First he found his own brother Shim‛on and said to him,
items.kk: First he found his own brother sheem-ohn and said to him,

items.name: andri
items.text: “We have found the Mashiach”
items.kk: We have found the mah-shee-ahk

items.name: narrator
items.text: And he brought him to Yahusha. And looking at him, Yahusha said,
items.kk: And he brought him to yah-hoo-shah. And looking at him, yah-hoo-shah said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You are Shim‛on, the son of Yonah, you shall be called Kĕpha”
items.kk: You are sheem-ohn, the son of yoh-nah, you shall be called kay-fah

items.name: narrator
items.text: On the following day Yahusha wished to go to Galil, and He found Philip and said to him,
items.kk: On the following day yah-hoo-shah wished to go to gah-leel, and He found Philip and said to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Follow Me.”
items.kk: Follow Me.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Philip was from Bĕyth Tsaiḏa, the city of Andri and Kĕpha.
items.kk: And Philip was from bayt Tsaida, the city of ahn-dree and kay-fah.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Philip found Nethanĕ’l and said to him,
items.kk: Philip found Nethanel and said to him,

items.name: philip
items.text: “We have found Him whom Mosheh wrote of in the Torah, and the naḇi'im: Yahusha of Natsareth – the son of Yosĕph.”
items.kk: We have found Him whom Mosheh wrote of in the toh-rah, and the nabiim, yah-hoo-shah of nahts-ah-ret, the son of yoh-sef.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Nethanĕ’l said to him,
items.kk: And Nethanel said to him,

items.name: nethanel
items.text: “Is it possible for any good matter to come out of Natsareth?”
items.kk: Is it possible for any good matter to come out of nahts-ah-ret?

items.name: narrator
items.text: Philip said to him,
items.kk: Philip said to him,

items.name: philip
items.text: “Come and see.”
items.kk: Come and see.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha saw Nethanĕ’l coming toward Him, and said of him,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah saw Nethanel coming toward Him, and said of him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “See, truly a Yahsra’Alite, in whom is no deceit!”
items.kk: See, truly a YahsraAlite, in whom is no deceit!

items.name: narrator
items.text: Nethanĕ’l said to Him,
items.kk: Nethanel said to Him,

items.name: nethanel
items.text: “From where do You know me?”
items.kk: From where do You know me?

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha answered and said to him,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah answered and said to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
items.kk: Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Nethanĕ’l answered and said to Him,
items.kk: Nethanel answered and said to Him,

items.name: nethanel
items.text: “Rabbi, You are the Son of Aluahim! You are the Sovereign of Yasharal!”
items.kk: Rabbi, You are the Son of al-oo-ah-heem! You are the Sovereign of yah-shar-al!

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Because I said to you, ‘I saw you under the fig tree,’ do you believe? Greater than that you shall see.”
items.kk: Because I said to you, I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? Greater than that you shall see.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He said to him,
items.kk: And He said to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, from now on you shall see the shamayim opened and the mal'akim of Aluahim ascending and descending upon the Son of Aḏam.”
items.kk: Truly, truly, I say to you, from now on you shall see the shah-mah-yeem opened and the mahl-ah-keem of al-oo-ah-heem ascending and descending upon the Son of Adam.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Nobody could have seen him under it from the road. You looked yourself, and you could not.
items.kk: Nobody could have seen him under it from the road. You looked yourself, and you could not.

items.name: narrator
items.text: “I didn’t,” he says. “I only said, come and see.”
items.kk: I didn't, he says. I only said, come and see.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And there was a man of the Pharisees, Naḵdimon was his name, a ruler of the Yahuḏim.
items.kk: And there was a man of the Pharisees, Nakdimon was his name, a ruler of the yah-hoo-deem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: This one came to Yahusha by night and said to Him,
items.kk: This one came to yah-hoo-shah by night and said to Him,

items.name: nakdimon
items.text: “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from Aluahim, for no one is able to do these signs You do if Aluahim is not with him.”
items.kk: Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from al-oo-ah-heem, for no one is able to do these signs You do if al-oo-ah-heem is not with him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born from above, he is unable to see the reign of Aluahim.”
items.kk: Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born from above, he is unable to see the reign of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Naḵdimon said to Him,
items.kk: Nakdimon said to Him,

items.name: nakdimon
items.text: “How is a man able to be born when he is old? Is he able to enter into his mother’s womb a second time and be born?”
items.kk: How is a man able to be born when he is old? Is he able to enter into his mother's womb a second time and be born?

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha answered,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah answered,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born of water and the Ruach, he is unable to enter into the reign of Aluahim.
items.kk: Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born of water and the roo-ahk, he is unable to enter into the reign of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “That which has been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which has been born of the Ruach is ruach.
items.kk: That which has been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which has been born of the roo-ahk is roo-ahk.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘You have to be born from above.’
items.kk: Do not marvel that I said to you, You have to be born from above.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “The Ruach breathes where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but do not know where it comes from and where it goes. So is everyone who has been born of the Ruach.”
items.kk: The roo-ahk breathes where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but do not know where it comes from and where it goes. So is everyone who has been born of the roo-ahk.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Naḵdimon answered and said to Him,
items.kk: Nakdimon answered and said to Him,

items.name: nakdimon
items.text: “How is it possible for this to take place?”
items.kk: How is it possible for this to take place?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Are you the teacher of Yasharal, and do not know this?
items.kk: Are you the teacher of yah-shar-al, and do not know this?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, We speak what We know and witness what We have seen, and you do not receive Our witness.
items.kk: Truly, truly, I say to you, We speak what We know and witness what We have seen, and you do not receive Our witness.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “If you do not believe when I spoke to you about earthly matters, how are you going to believe when I speak to you about the heavenly matters?
items.kk: If you do not believe when I spoke to you about earthly matters, how are you going to believe when I speak to you about the heavenly matters?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And no one has gone up into the shamayim except He who came down from the shamayim – the Son of Aḏam.
items.kk: And no one has gone up into the shah-mah-yeem except He who came down from the shah-mah-yeem, the Son of Adam.

items.name: narrator
items.text: In the wilderness, when the people were bitten by serpents, Mosheh made a serpent of bronze and set it on a pole, and whoever looked at it lived (Bemidbar 21:8-9).
items.kk: In the wilderness, when the people were bitten by serpents, Mosheh made a serpent of bronze and set it on a pole, and whoever looked at it lived Bemidbar 21,8, 9.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And as Mosheh lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so the Son of Aḏam has to be lifted up,
items.kk: And as Mosheh lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so the Son of Adam has to be lifted up,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: so that whoever is believing in Him should not perish but possess everlasting life.
items.kk: so that whoever is believing in Him should not perish but possess everlasting life.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For Aluahim so loved the world that He gave His only brought-forth Son, so that everyone who believes in Him should not perish but possess everlasting life.
items.kk: For al-oo-ah-heem so loved the world that He gave His only brought-forth Son, so that everyone who believes in Him should not perish but possess everlasting life.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For Aluahim did not send His Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world through Him might be saved.
items.kk: For al-oo-ah-heem did not send His Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world through Him might be saved.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: ”He who believes in Him is not judged, but he who does not believe is judged already, because he has not believed in the Name of the only brought-forth Son of Aluahim.
items.kk: He who believes in Him is not judged, but he who does not believe is judged already, because he has not believed in the Name of the only brought-forth Son of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And this is the mishpat, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were wicked.
items.kk: And this is the mishpat, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were wicked.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For everyone who is practising evil matters hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his works should be exposed.
items.kk: For everyone who is practising evil matters hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his works should be exposed.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But the one doing the truth comes to the light, so that his works are clearly seen, that they have been wrought in Aluahim.”
items.kk: But the one doing the truth comes to the light, so that his works are clearly seen, that they have been wrought in al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He pulls his mantle up over his head before he steps out of the lamplight. He does not hurry.
items.kk: He pulls his mantle up over his head before he steps out of the lamplight. He does not hurry.

items.name: narrator
items.text: You trimmed it once tonight. It is still burning.
items.kk: You trimmed it once tonight. It is still burning.

items.name: narrator
items.text: After this, Yahusha and His taught ones came into the land of Yahuḏah, and He remained there with them, and was immersing.
items.kk: After this, yah-hoo-shah and His taught ones came into the land of yah-hoo-dah, and He remained there with them, and was immersing.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahuchanon was also immersing in Ayin near Salim, because there was plenty of water there. And they were coming and were being immersed,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-kah-nohn was also immersing in Ayin near Salim, because there was plenty of water there. And they were coming and were being immersed,

items.name: narrator
items.text: for Yahuchanon had not yet been put into prison.
items.kk: for yah-hoo-kah-nohn had not yet been put into prison.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Herodes Antipas, tetrarch of Galil and Perea, would put Yahuchanon in chains in his fortress of Machaerus, above the Salt Sea, because he had said it was not right for him to have his brother’s wife (Mark 6:17-18).
items.kk: Herodes Antipas, tetrarch of gah-leel and Perea, would put yah-hoo-kah-nohn in chains in his fortress of Machaerus, above the Salt Sea, because he had said it was not right for him to have his brother's wife Mark 6,17, 18.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Then a dispute arose between some of Yahuchanon’s taught ones and the Yahuḏim about cleansing,
items.kk: Then a dispute arose between some of yah-hoo-kah-nohns taught ones and the yah-hoo-deem about cleansing,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and they came to Yahuchanon and said to him,
items.kk: and they came to yah-hoo-kah-nohn and said to him,

items.name: two taught ones of yahuchanon
items.text: “Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the Yardĕn, to whom you have witnessed, see, He is immersing, and all are coming to Him!”
items.kk: Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the yar-den, to whom you have witnessed, see, He is immersing, and all are coming to Him!

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahuchanon answered and said,
items.kk: yah-hoo-kah-nohn answered and said,

items.name: yahuchanon
items.text: “No man is able to receive any matter unless it is given to him from the shamayim.
items.kk: No man is able to receive any matter unless it is given to him from the shah-mah-yeem.

items.name: yahuchanon
items.text: “You yourselves are witnesses for me that I said, ‘I am not the Mashiach but I am sent ahead of Him.’
items.kk: You yourselves are witnesses for me that I said, I am not the mah-shee-ahk but I am sent ahead of Him.

items.name: yahuchanon
items.text: ”He that has the bride is the bridegroom, but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the voice of the bridegroom. So this joy of mine is complete.
items.kk: He that has the bride is the bridegroom, but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the voice of the bridegroom. So this joy of mine is complete.

items.name: yahuchanon
items.text: “It is right for Him to increase, but me to decrease.
items.kk: It is right for Him to increase, but me to decrease.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He said he was only a voice. You have heard it now for a long time, and it has never once spoken of itself.
items.kk: He said he was only a voice. You have heard it now for a long time, and it has never once spoken of itself.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The river runs on down to the Salt Sea, as it always has. The people keep coming down to it.
items.kk: The river runs on down to the Salt Sea, as it always has. The people keep coming down to it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: So when the Master knew that the Pharisees had heard that Yahusha made and immersed more taught ones than Yahuchanon –
items.kk: So when the Master knew that the Pharisees had heard that yah-hoo-shah made and immersed more taught ones than yah-hoo-kah-nohn,

items.name: narrator
items.text: although Yahusha Himself did not immerse, but His taught ones –
items.kk: although yah-hoo-shah Himself did not immerse, but His taught ones,

items.name: narrator
items.text: He left Yahuḏah and went away again to Galil.
items.kk: He left yah-hoo-dah and went away again to gah-leel.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He had to pass through Shomeron.
items.kk: And He had to pass through Shomeron.

items.name: narrator
items.text: So He came to a city of Shomeron, called Sheḵem, near the piece of land Ya‛aqoḇ gave to his son Yosĕph.
items.kk: So He came to a city of Shomeron, called Shekem, near the piece of land Yaaqob gave to his son yoh-sef.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Ya‛aqoḇ’s fountain is a well cut deep into the rock at the foot of Mount Gerizim; it is still drawn from today. The sixth hour is about noon — the heat of the day, when no one comes to draw water.
items.kk: Yaaqobs fountain is a well cut deep into the rock at the foot of Mount Gerizim, it is still drawn from today. The sixth hour is about noon, the heat of the day, when no one comes to draw water.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Ya‛aqoḇ’s fountain was there. So Yahusha, being wearied from the journey, was sitting thus at the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.
items.kk: And Yaaqobs fountain was there. So yah-hoo-shah, being wearied from the journey, was sitting thus at the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A woman of Shomeron came to draw water. Yahusha said to her,
items.kk: A woman of Shomeron came to draw water. yah-hoo-shah said to her,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Give Me to drink.”
items.kk: Give Me to drink.

items.name: narrator
items.text: For His taught ones had gone off into the city to buy food.
items.kk: For His taught ones had gone off into the city to buy food.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The woman of Shomeron therefore said to Him,
items.kk: The woman of Shomeron therefore said to Him,

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “How is it that You, being a Yahuḏite, ask a drink from me, a woman of Shomeron?”
items.kk: How is it that You, being a Yahudite, ask a drink from me, a woman of Shomeron?

items.name: narrator
items.text: For Yahuḏim do not associate with Shomeronites.
items.kk: For yah-hoo-deem do not associate with Shomeronites.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha answered and said to her,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah answered and said to her,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “If you knew the gift of Aluahim, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give Me to drink,’ you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
items.kk: If you knew the gift of al-oo-ah-heem, and who it is who says to you, Give Me to drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The woman said to Him,
items.kk: The woman said to Him,

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “Master, You have no vessel, and the well is deep. From where, then, do You have living water?
items.kk: Master, You have no vessel, and the well is deep. From where, then, do You have living water?

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “Are You greater than our father Ya‛aqoḇ, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, and his sons, and his cattle?”
items.kk: Are You greater than our father Yaaqob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, and his sons, and his cattle?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Everyone drinking of this water shall thirst again,
items.kk: Everyone drinking of this water shall thirst again,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: but whoever drinks of the water I give him shall certainly never thirst. And the water that I give him shall become in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life.”
items.kk: but whoever drinks of the water I give him shall certainly never thirst. And the water that I give him shall become in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life.

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “Master, give me this water, so that I do not thirst, nor come here to draw.”
items.kk: Master, give me this water, so that I do not thirst, nor come here to draw.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha said to her,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah said to her,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
items.kk: Go, call your husband, and come here.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The woman answered and said,
items.kk: The woman answered and said,

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “I have no husband.”
items.kk: I have no husband.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You have well said,‘I have no husband,’
items.kk: You have well said,I have no husband,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband. What you have said is true.”
items.kk: for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband. What you have said is true.

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “Master, I see that You are a naḇi.
items.kk: Master, I see that You are a nah-vee.

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “Our fathers worshipped on this mountain, but you people say that in Yahrushalayim is the place where one needs to worship.”
items.kk: Our fathers worshipped on this mountain, but you people say that in yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem is the place where one needs to worship.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming when you shall neither on this mountain, nor in Yahrushalayim, worship the Father.
items.kk: Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming when you shall neither on this mountain, nor in yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem, worship the Father.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You worship what you do not know. We worship what we know, because the deliverance is of the Yahuḏim.
items.kk: You worship what you do not know. We worship what we know, because the deliverance is of the yah-hoo-deem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in ruach and truth, for the Father also does seek such to worship Him.
items.kk: But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in roo-ahk and truth, for the Father also does seek such to worship Him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Aluahim is Ruach, and those who worship Him need to worship in ruach and truth.”
items.kk: al-oo-ah-heem is roo-ahk, and those who worship Him need to worship in roo-ahk and truth.

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “I know that Mashiach is coming, the One who is called Anointed. When that One comes, He shall announce to us all.”
items.kk: I know that mah-shee-ahk is coming, the One who is called Anointed. When that One comes, He shall announce to us all.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I who am speaking to you am He.”
items.kk: I who am speaking to you am He.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And upon this His taught ones came, and they were marvelling that He was speaking with a woman, however, no one said,
items.kk: And upon this His taught ones came, and they were marvelling that He was speaking with a woman, however, no one said,

items.name: narrator
items.text: “What do You seek?”
items.kk: What do You seek?

items.name: narrator
items.text: or,
items.kk: or,

items.name: narrator
items.text: “Why do You speak with her?”
items.kk: Why do You speak with her?

items.name: narrator
items.text: The woman then left her water-jug, and went away to the city, and said to the men,
items.kk: The woman then left her water-jug, and went away to the city, and said to the men,

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: ”Come, see a Man who told me all that I have done. Is this not the Mashiach?”
items.kk: Come, see a Man who told me all that I have done. Is this not the mah-shee-ahk?

items.name: narrator
items.text: They went out of the city and were coming to Him.
items.kk: They went out of the city and were coming to Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But in the meantime His taught ones were asking Him, saying,
items.kk: But in the meantime His taught ones were asking Him, saying,

items.name: taught
items.text: “Rabbi, eat.”
items.kk: Rabbi, eat.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I have food to eat of which you do not know.”
items.kk: I have food to eat of which you do not know.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Then the taught ones said to each other,
items.kk: Then the taught ones said to each other,

items.name: taught
items.text: “Did anyone bring Him food to eat?”
items.kk: Did anyone bring Him food to eat?

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha said to them,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “My food is to do the desire of Him who sent Me,and to accomplish His work.
items.kk: My food is to do the desire of Him who sent Me,and to accomplish His work.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Do you not say, ‘There are still four months, and the harvest comes’? See, I say to you, lift up your eyes and see the fields, for they are white for harvest – already!
items.kk: Do you not say, There are still four months, and the harvest comes? See, I say to you, lift up your eyes and see the fields, for they are white for harvest, already!

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: ”He who is reaping receives a reward and gathers fruit for everlasting life, so that both he who is sowing and he who is reaping rejoice together.
items.kk: He who is reaping receives a reward and gathers fruit for everlasting life, so that both he who is sowing and he who is reaping rejoice together.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For in this the word is true, ‘One sows and another reaps.’
items.kk: For in this the word is true, One sows and another reaps.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I sent you to reap that for which you have not laboured. Others have laboured, and you have entered into their labours.”
items.kk: I sent you to reap that for which you have not laboured. Others have laboured, and you have entered into their labours.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And many of the Shomeronites of that city believed in Him because of the word of the woman who witnessed,
items.kk: And many of the Shomeronites of that city believed in Him because of the word of the woman who witnessed,

items.name: woman of shomeron
items.text: “He told me all that I have done.”
items.kk: He told me all that I have done.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Therefore when the Shomeronites came to Him, they were asking Him to stay with them, and He stayed there two days.
items.kk: Therefore when the Shomeronites came to Him, they were asking Him to stay with them, and He stayed there two days.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And many more believed because of His word.
items.kk: And many more believed because of His word.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they said to the woman,
items.kk: And they said to the woman,

items.name: shomeronites
items.text: “We no longer believe because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard, and we know that this is truly the Mashiach, the Saviour of the world.”
items.kk: We no longer believe because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard, and we know that this is truly the mah-shee-ahk, the Saviour of the world.

items.name: narrator
items.text: She came out at noon so that nobody would see her. She went back into the town to tell everybody.
items.kk: She came out at noon so that nobody would see her. She went back into the town to tell everybody.

items.name: narrator
items.text: White for harvest. Coming through the wheat on the road, more of them, and more.
items.kk: White for harvest. Coming through the wheat on the road, more of them, and more.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The end of Act III. Next: Galil — Qanah, “the beginning of the signs” (Yahuchanon 2:11)
items.kk: The end of Act three. Next, gah-leel, Qanah, the beginning of the signs yah-hoo-kah-nohn 2,11

items.name: narrator
items.text: Act IV · Galil. Qanah · Natsareth · Kephar Naḥum · the Sea of Galil
items.kk: Act four gah-leel. Qanah nahts-ah-ret Kephar Nakum the Sea of gah-leel

items.name: narrator
items.text: You went north with them from the Yardĕn into Galil. The hill villages here are a day’s walk from the lake; Qanah lies a few miles north of Natsareth.
items.kk: You went north with them from the yar-den into gah-leel. The hill villages here are a day's walk from the lake, Qanah lies a few miles north of nahts-ah-ret.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And on the third day there was a wedding in Qanah of Galil, and the mother of Yahusha was there.
items.kk: And on the third day there was a wedding in Qanah of gah-leel, and the mother of yah-hoo-shah was there.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And both Yahusha and His taught ones were invited to the wedding.
items.kk: And both yah-hoo-shah and His taught ones were invited to the wedding.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when they were short of wine, the mother of Yahusha said to Him,
items.kk: And when they were short of wine, the mother of yah-hoo-shah said to Him,

items.name: miryam
items.text: “They have no wine.”
items.kk: They have no wine.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Woman, what is that to Me and to you? My hour has not yet come.”
items.kk: Woman, what is that to Me and to you? My hour has not yet come.

items.name: narrator
items.text: His mother said to the servants,
items.kk: His mother said to the servants,

items.name: miryam
items.text: “Do whatever He says to you.”
items.kk: Do whatever He says to you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And there were six stone water-jugs standing there, according to the mode of cleansing of the Yahuḏim, each holding two or three measures.
items.kk: And there were six stone water-jugs standing there, according to the mode of cleansing of the yah-hoo-deem, each holding two or three measures.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Fill the water-jugs with water.”
items.kk: Fill the water-jugs with water.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they filled them up to the brim.
items.kk: And they filled them up to the brim.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Now draw out and take it to the master of the feast.”
items.kk: Now draw out and take it to the master of the feast.

items.name: narrator
items.text: So they took it.
items.kk: So they took it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But when the master of the feast had tasted the water that had become wine, and did not know where it came from – though the servants who had drawn the water knew – the master of the feast called the bridegroom,
items.kk: But when the master of the feast had tasted the water that had become wine, and did not know where it came from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew, the master of the feast called the bridegroom,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and said to him,
items.kk: and said to him,

items.name: master
items.text: “Every man at the beginning sets out the good wine and, when they have drunk, then that which is poorer. You have kept the good wine until now.”
items.kk: Every man at the beginning sets out the good wine and, when they have drunk, then that which is poorer. You have kept the good wine until now.

items.name: narrator
items.text: This, the beginning of the signs, Yahusha did in Qanah of Galil, and manifested His esteem. And His taught ones believed in Him.
items.kk: This, the beginning of the signs, yah-hoo-shah did in Qanah of gah-leel, and manifested His esteem. And His taught ones believed in Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: You carried that water up from the well yourself, jar after jar. You know what you poured in.
items.kk: You carried that water up from the well yourself, jar after jar. You know what you poured in.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The servants who drew the water knew. You were one of them.
items.kk: The servants who drew the water knew. You were one of them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha returned in the power of the Ruach to Galil and news of Him went out through all the surrounding country. And He was teaching in their qahalim, being praised by all.
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah returned in the power of the roo-ahk to gah-leel and news of Him went out through all the surrounding country. And He was teaching in their qahalim, being praised by all.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He came to Natsareth, where He had been brought up. And according to His practice, He went into the qahal on the Shabbath day and stood up to read.
items.kk: And He came to nahts-ah-ret, where He had been brought up. And according to His practice, He went into the qahal on the Shabbath day and stood up to read.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the scroll of the naḇi Yahshayahu was handed to Him. And having unrolled the scroll, He found the place where it was written:
items.kk: And the scroll of the nah-vee yah-shah-yah-hoo was handed to Him. And having unrolled the scroll, He found the place where it was written,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “The Ruach of (YAHUAH) HWHY is upon Me, because He has anointed Me to bring the Besorah to the poor. He has sent Me to heal the broken-hearted, to proclaim release to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to send away crushed ones with a release, to proclaim the acceptable year of (YAHUAH) HWHY.”
items.kk: The roo-ahk of YAHUAH is upon Me, because He has anointed Me to bring the beh-soh-rah to the poor. He has sent Me to heal the broken-hearted, to proclaim release to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to send away crushed ones with a release, to proclaim the acceptable year of YAHUAH.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having rolled up the scroll, He gave it back to the attendant and sat down. And the eyes of all in the qahal were fixed upon Him.
items.kk: And having rolled up the scroll, He gave it back to the attendant and sat down. And the eyes of all in the qahal were fixed upon Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He began to say to them,
items.kk: And He began to say to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Today this Scripture has been filled in your hearing.”
items.kk: Today this Scripture has been filled in your hearing.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And all were bearing witness to Him and marvelled at the pleasant words that came out of His mouth. And they said,
items.kk: And all were bearing witness to Him and marvelled at the pleasant words that came out of His mouth. And they said,

items.name: those in the qahal
items.text: “Is this not the son of Yosĕph?”
items.kk: Is this not the son of yoh-sef?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “No doubt, you shall say this proverb to Me, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard being done in Kephar Naḥum, do also here in Your country.’ ”
items.kk: No doubt, you shall say this proverb to Me, Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard being done in Kephar Nakum, do also here in Your country.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He said,
items.kk: And He said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you, no naḇi is accepted in his own country.
items.kk: Truly, I say to you, no nah-vee is accepted in his own country.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But truly I say to you, many widows were in Yasharal in the days of Aliyahu, when the shamayim was shut up for three years and six months and there was a great scarcity of food in all the land, and Aliyahu was sent to none of them, but to Tsarephath of Tsiḏon, to a woman, a widow.
items.kk: But truly I say to you, many widows were in yah-shar-al in the days of ah-lee-yah-hoo, when the shah-mah-yeem was shut up for three years and six months and there was a great scarcity of food in all the land, and ah-lee-yah-hoo was sent to none of them, but to Tsarephath of Tsidon, to a woman, a widow.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And many lepers were in Yasharal in the time of Alisha the naḇi and none of them was cleansed except Na‛aman the Aramean.”
items.kk: And many lepers were in yah-shar-al in the time of Alisha the nah-vee and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Aramean.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The sixth of the seven words. Your father’s fathers copied them in Yahrushalayim, and you have just heard them read — and filled.
items.kk: The sixth of the seven words. Your father's fathers copied them in yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem, and you have just heard them read, and filled.

items.name: narrator
items.text: They have known Him since He was a boy. You see the warmth go out of them.
items.kk: They have known Him since He was a boy. You see the warmth go out of them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And all those in the qahal, when they heard this, were filled with wrath. And rising up they drove Him out of the city and brought Him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, in order to throw Him down.
items.kk: And all those in the qahal, when they heard this, were filled with wrath. And rising up they drove Him out of the city and brought Him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, in order to throw Him down.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But He, passing through the midst of them, went away.
items.kk: But He, passing through the midst of them, went away.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And it came to be, while the crowd was pressing upon Him to hear the word of Aluahim, that He stood by the Lake of Gennĕsar,
items.kk: And it came to be, while the crowd was pressing upon Him to hear the word of al-oo-ah-heem, that He stood by the Lake of Gennesar,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone from them and were washing their nets.
items.kk: and He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone from them and were washing their nets.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And entering into one of the boats, which belonged to Shim‛on, He asked him to pull away a little from the land. And He sat down and was teaching the crowds from the boat.
items.kk: And entering into one of the boats, which belonged to sheem-ohn, He asked him to pull away a little from the land. And He sat down and was teaching the crowds from the boat.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when He ceased speaking, He said to Shim‛on,
items.kk: And when He ceased speaking, He said to sheem-ohn,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Pull out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
items.kk: Pull out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Shim‛on answering, said to Him,
items.kk: And sheem-ohn answering, said to Him,

items.name: shimon
items.text: “Master, we have toiled all night and caught none but at Your word I shall let down the net.”
items.kk: Master, we have toiled all night and caught none but at Your word I shall let down the net.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when they did so, they caught a great number of fish and their net was breaking, and they motioned to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they were sinking.
items.kk: And when they did so, they caught a great number of fish and their net was breaking, and they motioned to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they were sinking.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when Shim‛on Kĕpha saw it, he fell down at the knees of Yahusha, saying,
items.kk: And when sheem-ohn kay-fah saw it, he fell down at the knees of yah-hoo-shah, saying,

items.name: shimon
items.text: “Depart from me, for I am a man, a sinner, O Master!”
items.kk: Depart from me, for I am a man, a sinner, O Master!

items.name: narrator
items.text: For astonishment had seized him and all those with him, at the catch of fish which they took,
items.kk: For astonishment had seized him and all those with him, at the catch of fish which they took,

items.name: narrator
items.text: so too were Ya‛aqoḇ and Yahuchanon, the sons of Zaḇdai, who were partners with Shim‛on. Then Yahusha said to Shim‛on,
items.kk: so too were Yaaqob and yah-hoo-kah-nohn, the sons of Zabdai, who were partners with sheem-ohn. Then yah-hoo-shah said to sheem-ohn,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Do not fear, from now on you shall catch men.”
items.kk: Do not fear, from now on you shall catch men.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having brought the boats to land, they left all and followed Him.
items.kk: And having brought the boats to land, they left all and followed Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Two boats full, the best catch the lake has given in years, and they walk away from it. So do you.
items.kk: Two boats full, the best catch the lake has given in years, and they walk away from it. So do you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The old man waves you off. "Go," he says. You go.
items.kk: The old man waves you off. Go, he says. You go.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they went into Kephar Naḥum and immediately on the Shabbath He went into the qahal and taught.
items.kk: And they went into Kephar Nakum and immediately on the Shabbath He went into the qahal and taught.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they were astonished at His teaching, for He was teaching them as possessing authority and not as the scribes.
items.kk: And they were astonished at His teaching, for He was teaching them as possessing authority and not as the scribes.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And there was a man in their qahal with an unclean ruach and he cried out, saying,
items.kk: And there was a man in their qahal with an unclean roo-ahk and he cried out, saying,

items.name: unclean
items.text: “Ha! What have we to do with You, Yahusha of Natsareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are: the Qadash (Set Apart One) of Aluahim!”
items.kk: Ha! What have we to do with You, yah-hoo-shah of nahts-ah-ret? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are, the kah-dahsh of al-oo-ah-heem!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha rebuked him, saying,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah rebuked him, saying,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Be silenced and come out of Him!”
items.kk: Be silenced and come out of Him!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And throwing him into convulsions, the unclean ruach called out with a loud voice and came out of him.
items.kk: And throwing him into convulsions, the unclean roo-ahk called out with a loud voice and came out of him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they were all so amazed, as to reason among themselves, saying,
items.kk: And they were all so amazed, as to reason among themselves, saying,

items.name: kephar
items.text: “What is this, a fresh teaching? With authority He commands even the unclean ruchot and they obey Him!”
items.kk: What is this, a fresh teaching? With authority He commands even the unclean ruchot and they obey Him!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And news about Him immediately spread into all the country around Galil.
items.kk: And news about Him immediately spread into all the country around gah-leel.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And coming out of the qahal, they went straight to the house of Shim‛on and Andri, with Ya‛aqoḇ and Yahuchanon.
items.kk: And coming out of the qahal, they went straight to the house of sheem-ohn and ahn-dree, with Yaaqob and yah-hoo-kah-nohn.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the mother-in-law of Shim‛on lay sick with inflammation and immediately they spoke to Him about her.
items.kk: And the mother-in-law of sheem-ohn lay sick with inflammation and immediately they spoke to Him about her.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having come, He took her by the hand and lifted her up and immediately the inflammation left her and she served them.
items.kk: And having come, He took her by the hand and lifted her up and immediately the inflammation left her and she served them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The Shabbath ended at sunset. Until then nothing might be carried through the streets — so the sick were brought only “when the sun had set”.
items.kk: The Shabbath ended at sunset. Until then nothing might be carried through the streets, so the sick were brought only when the sun had set.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when evening came, when the sun had set, they brought to Him all who were sick and those who were demon possessed.
items.kk: And when evening came, when the sun had set, they brought to Him all who were sick and those who were demon possessed.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the entire city had gathered at the door.
items.kk: And the entire city had gathered at the door.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons and was not allowing the demons to speak, because they knew Him.
items.kk: And He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons and was not allowing the demons to speak, because they knew Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: She is going among the crowd at the door with water. She does not look like someone who was in bed at noon.
items.kk: She is going among the crowd at the door with water. She does not look like someone who was in bed at noon.

items.name: narrator
items.text: All through the evening they keep coming, carried and led. Nobody is sent away.
items.kk: All through the evening they keep coming, carried and led. Nobody is sent away.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And some days later He again entered into Kephar Naḥum and it was heard that He was in the house.
items.kk: And some days later He again entered into Kephar Nakum and it was heard that He was in the house.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And so many gathered together, that there was no more room, not even at the door. And He spoke the Word to them.
items.kk: And so many gathered together, that there was no more room, not even at the door. And He spoke the Word to them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they came to Him, bringing a paralytic, carried by four.
items.kk: And they came to Him, bringing a paralytic, carried by four.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And not being able to come near Him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where He was. And when they had broken through, they let down the bed on which the paralytic was lying.
items.kk: And not being able to come near Him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where He was. And when they had broken through, they let down the bed on which the paralytic was lying.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when Yahusha saw their belief, He said to the paralytic,
items.kk: And when yah-hoo-shah saw their belief, He said to the paralytic,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
items.kk: Son, your sins are forgiven you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Now some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
items.kk: Now some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

items.name: scribes
items.text: “Why does this One talk like this? He is blaspheming! Who is able to forgive sins but Aluahim alone?”
items.kk: Why does this One talk like this? He is blaspheming! Who is able to forgive sins but al-oo-ah-heem alone?

items.name: narrator
items.text: Immediately Yahusha, knowing in His ruach that they were reasoning that way within themselves, said to them,
items.kk: Immediately yah-hoo-shah, knowing in His roo-ahk that they were reasoning that way within themselves, said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Why do you reason about all this in your hearts?
items.kk: Why do you reason about all this in your hearts?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Rise, take up your bed and walk’?
items.kk: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Rise, take up your bed and walk?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But in order for you to know that the Son of Aḏam possesses authority on earth to forgive sins...”
items.kk: But in order for you to know that the Son of Adam possesses authority on earth to forgive sins.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He said to the paralytic,
items.kk: He said to the paralytic,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I say to you, rise, take up your bed and go to your house.”
items.kk: I say to you, rise, take up your bed and go to your house.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He rose straightaway, took up the bed and went out before all, so that all were amazed and praised Aluahim, saying,
items.kk: He rose straightaway, took up the bed and went out before all, so that all were amazed and praised al-oo-ah-heem, saying,

items.name: kephar
items.text: “We have never seen the like of it!”
items.kk: We have never seen the like of it!

items.name: narrator
items.text: Somebody will have to mend it tonight. You think Shim‛on will not mind.
items.kk: Somebody will have to mend it tonight. You think sheem-ohn will not mind.

items.name: narrator
items.text: “Your sins are forgiven.” He said that before He said anything about walking.
items.kk: Your sins are forgiven. He said that before He said anything about walking.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Kephar Naḥum stood on the road along the lake, at the edge of the land of Herodes Antipas, tetrarch of Galil. Tolls on the goods that came along it were gathered here.
items.kk: Kephar Nakum stood on the road along the lake, at the edge of the land of Herodes Antipas, tetrarch of gah-leel. Tolls on the goods that came along it were gathered here.

items.name: narrator

items.text: But when He saw the crowds, He went up on a mountain and when He was seated His taught ones came to Him. And having opened His mouth, He was teaching them, saying,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Baruk are the poor in ruach, because theirs is the reign of the shamayim. “Baruk are those who mourn, because they shall be comforted. “Baruk are the meek, because they shall inherit the earth. “Baruk are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, because they shall be filled.
items.kk: Baruk are the poor in roo-ahk, because theirs is the reign of the shah-mah-yeem. Baruk are those who mourn, because they shall be comforted. Baruk are the meek, because they shall inherit the earth. Baruk are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, because they shall be filled.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Baruk are the compassionate, because they shall obtain compassion. “Baruk are the clean in heart, because they shall see Aluahim. “Baruk are the peacemakers, because they shall be called sons of Aluahim. “Baruk are those persecuted for righteousness’ sake, because theirs is the reign of the shamayim.
items.kk: Baruk are the compassionate, because they shall obtain compassion. Baruk are the clean in heart, because they shall see al-oo-ah-heem. Baruk are the peacemakers, because they shall be called sons of al-oo-ah-heem. Baruk are those persecuted for righteousness sake, because theirs is the reign of the shah-mah-yeem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Baruk are you when they reproach and persecute you and falsely say every wicked word against you, for My sake. “Rejoice and be glad, because your reward in the shamayim is great. For in this way they persecuted the naḇi'im who were before you.
items.kk: Baruk are you when they reproach and persecute you and falsely say every wicked word against you, for My sake. Rejoice and be glad, because your reward in the shah-mah-yeem is great. For in this way they persecuted the nabiim who were before you.

items.text: “And I say to you that many shall come from east and west and sit down with Aḇrahim and Yahtsḥaq and Ya‛aqoḇ in the reign of the shamayim, but the sons of the reign shall be cast out into outer darkness – there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

items.kk: See, the sower went out to sow.

items.kk: And as he sowed, some indeed fell by the wayside and the birds came and devoured them.

items.kk: And others fell on rocky places, where they did not have much soil and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of soil.

items.kk: He who has ears to hear let him hear!

items.kk: The reign of the shah-mah-yeem is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal until all was leavened.
