items.name: shimon
items.text: “Be kind to Yourself, Master, this shall not be to You!”
items.kk: Be kind to Yourself, Master, this shall not be to You!

items.name: narrator
items.text: But He turned and said to Kĕpha,
items.kk: But He turned and said to kay-fah,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me, for your thoughts are not those of Aluahim, but those of men.”
items.kk: Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me, for your thoughts are not those of al-oo-ah-heem, but those of men.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Then Yahusha said to His taught ones,
items.kk: Then yah-hoo-shah said to His taught ones,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “If anyone wishes to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his stake and follow Me.
items.kk: If anyone wishes to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his stake and follow Me.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For whoever wishes to save his life shall lose it and whoever loses his life for My sake shall find it.
items.kk: For whoever wishes to save his life shall lose it and whoever loses his life for My sake shall find it.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For what is a man profited if he gains all the world and loses his own life? Or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
items.kk: For what is a man profited if he gains all the world and loses his own life? Or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For the Son of Aḏam is going to come in the esteem of His Father with His mal'akim and then He shall reward each according to his works.
items.kk: For the Son of Adam is going to come in the esteem of His Father with His mahl-ah-keem and then He shall reward each according to his works.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you, there are some standing here who shall not taste death at all until they see the Son of Aḏam coming in His reign:”
items.kk: Truly, I say to you, there are some standing here who shall not taste death at all until they see the Son of Adam coming in His reign,

items.name: narrator
items.text: A temple to a man who rules the world, set before a cave the Greeks call holy. And here a man of Natsareth whom a fisherman has just called the Son of the living Aluahim.
items.kk: A temple to a man who rules the world, set before a cave the Greeks call holy. And here a man of nahts-ah-ret whom a fisherman has just called the Son of the living al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Every man in the land knows what a stake means: the Romans set them up along the roads. You cannot make the words sit beside Him.
items.kk: Every man in the land knows what a stake means, the Romans set them up along the roads. You cannot make the words sit beside Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: You were not on the mountain. He took three, by themselves; the rest of you waited below. The three kept what they saw to themselves, as He ordered them, until He was raised from the dead — and this is told as they told it.
items.kk: You were not on the mountain. He took three, by themselves, the rest of you waited below. The three kept what they saw to themselves, as He ordered them, until He was raised from the dead, and this is told as they told it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And after six days Yahusha took Kĕpha and Ya‛aqoḇ and Yahuchanon his brother and brought them up on a high mountain by themselves,
items.kk: And after six days yah-hoo-shah took kay-fah and Yaaqob and yah-hoo-kah-nohn his brother and brought them up on a high mountain by themselves,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and He was transformed before them and His face shone like the sun and His garments became as white as the light.
items.kk: and He was transformed before them and His face shone like the sun and His garments became as white as the light.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And see, two men were talking with Him, who were Mosheh and Aliyahu, who having appeared in esteem, spoke of His death which He was about to complete at Yahrushalayim.
items.kk: And see, two men were talking with Him, who were Mosheh and ah-lee-yah-hoo, who having appeared in esteem, spoke of His death which He was about to complete at yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Kĕpha and those with him were heavy with sleep. And having awakened, they saw His esteem and the two men standing with Him.
items.kk: But kay-fah and those with him were heavy with sleep. And having awakened, they saw His esteem and the two men standing with Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Kĕpha answering, said to Yahusha,
items.kk: And kay-fah answering, said to yah-hoo-shah,

items.name: shimon
items.text: “Master, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, let us make here three booths: one for You, one for Mosheh and one for Aliyahu.”
items.kk: Master, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, let us make here three booths, one for You, one for Mosheh and one for ah-lee-yah-hoo.

items.name: narrator
items.text: While he was still speaking, see, a bright cloud overshadowed them. And see, a voice came out of the cloud, saying,
items.kk: While he was still speaking, see, a bright cloud overshadowed them. And see, a voice came out of the cloud, saying,

items.name: divine
items.who: A voice out of the cloud
items.text: “This is My Son, the Beloved, in whom I did delight. hear Him!”
items.kk: This is My Son, the Beloved, in whom I did delight. hear Him!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when the taught ones heard, they fell on their faces and were much afraid.
items.kk: And when the taught ones heard, they fell on their faces and were much afraid.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Yahusha came near and touched them and said,
items.kk: But yah-hoo-shah came near and touched them and said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Rise and do not be afraid.”
items.kk: Rise and do not be afraid.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having lifted up their eyes, they saw no one but Yahusha only.
items.kk: And having lifted up their eyes, they saw no one but yah-hoo-shah only.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as they were coming down from the mountain, Yahusha commanded them, saying,
items.kk: And as they were coming down from the mountain, yah-hoo-shah commanded them, saying,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Do not mention the vision to anyone until the Son of Aḏam is raised from the dead.”
items.kk: Do not mention the vision to anyone until the Son of Adam is raised from the dead.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And His taught ones asked Him, saying,
items.kk: And His taught ones asked Him, saying,

items.name: taught
items.text: “Why then do the scribes say that Aliyahu has to come first?”
items.kk: Why then do the scribes say that ah-lee-yah-hoo has to come first?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Aliyahu is indeed coming first and shall restore all matters.
items.kk: ah-lee-yah-hoo is indeed coming first and shall restore all matters.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But I say to you that Aliyahu has already come and they did not recognise him but did to him whatever they wished. In this way the Son of Aḏam is also about to suffer by them.”
items.kk: But I say to you that ah-lee-yah-hoo has already come and they did not recognise him but did to him whatever they wished. In this way the Son of Adam is also about to suffer by them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Then the taught ones understood that He had spoken to them about Yahuchanon the Immerser.
items.kk: Then the taught ones understood that He had spoken to them about yah-hoo-kah-nohn the Immerser.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And coming to the taught ones, He saw a large crowd around them and scribes disputing with them.
items.kk: And coming to the taught ones, He saw a large crowd around them and scribes disputing with them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And immediately, when all the crowd saw Him, they were greatly astonished and running near, greeted Him.
items.kk: And immediately, when all the crowd saw Him, they were greatly astonished and running near, greeted Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He asked the scribes,
items.kk: And He asked the scribes,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What are you disputing with them?”
items.kk: What are you disputing with them?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And one of the crowd answering, said,
items.kk: And one of the crowd answering, said,

items.name: father
items.text: “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a dumb ruach.
items.kk: Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a dumb roo-ahk.

items.name: father
items.text: “And wherever he seizes him, he throws him down and he foams at the mouth and gnashes his teeth and he wastes away. And I spoke to Your taught ones, that they should cast him out, but they were not able.”
items.kk: And wherever he seizes him, he throws him down and he foams at the mouth and gnashes his teeth and he wastes away. And I spoke to Your taught ones, that they should cast him out, but they were not able.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He answered him and said,
items.kk: And He answered him and said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “O unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring him to Me.”
items.kk: O unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring him to Me.

items.name: narrator
items.text: So they brought him to Him. And when he saw Him, immediately the ruach threw him into convulsions. And falling on the ground, he rolled about, foaming at the mouth.
items.kk: So they brought him to Him. And when he saw Him, immediately the roo-ahk threw him into convulsions. And falling on the ground, he rolled about, foaming at the mouth.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He asked his father,
items.kk: And He asked his father,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “How long has he been like this?”
items.kk: How long has he been like this?

items.name: father
items.text: “From childhood, and often he has thrown him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if it is at all possible for You, have compassion on us and help us.”
items.kk: From childhood, and often he has thrown him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if it is at all possible for You, have compassion on us and help us.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “If you are able to believe, all is possible to him who believes.”
items.kk: If you are able to believe, all is possible to him who believes.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And immediately the father of the child cried out and said with tears,
items.kk: And immediately the father of the child cried out and said with tears,

items.name: father
items.text: “I believe Master, help my unbelief!”
items.kk: I believe Master, help my unbelief!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when Yahusha saw that a crowd came running together, He rebuked the unclean ruach, saying to him,
items.kk: And when yah-hoo-shah saw that a crowd came running together, He rebuked the unclean roo-ahk, saying to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You deaf and dumb ruach, I order you, come out of him and never again enter into Him!”
items.kk: You deaf and dumb roo-ahk, I order you, come out of him and never again enter into Him!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And crying out and convulsing him much, it came out of him. And he became as one dead, so that many said that he was dead.
items.kk: And crying out and convulsing him much, it came out of him. And he became as one dead, so that many said that he was dead.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Yahusha, taking him by the hand, lifted him up and he arose.
items.kk: But yah-hoo-shah, taking him by the hand, lifted him up and he arose.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when He came into a house, His taught ones asked Him separately,
items.kk: And when He came into a house, His taught ones asked Him separately,

items.name: taught
items.text: “Why were we unable to cast him out?”
items.kk: Why were we unable to cast him out?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “It is impossible for this kind to come out except through prayer and fasting.”
items.kk: It is impossible for this kind to come out except through prayer and fasting.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And going from there they passed through Galil. And He did not wish anyone to know,
items.kk: And going from there they passed through gah-leel. And He did not wish anyone to know,

items.name: narrator
items.text: for He was teaching His taught ones and said to them,
items.kk: for He was teaching His taught ones and said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “The Son of Aḏam is being delivered into the hands of men and they shall kill Him. And having been killed, He shall rise the third day.”
items.kk: The Son of Adam is being delivered into the hands of men and they shall kill Him. And having been killed, He shall rise the third day.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But they did not understand the word and they were afraid to ask Him.
items.kk: But they did not understand the word and they were afraid to ask Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: “I believe Master, help my unbelief.” You have not heard a truer prayer. You find it is your own.
items.kk: I believe Master, help my unbelief. You have not heard a truer prayer. You find it is your own.

items.name: narrator
items.text: No one answers you. They are afraid to ask Him, and so are you.
items.kk: No one answers you. They are afraid to ask Him, and so are you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when they came into Kephar Naḥum, those who received the tax came to Kĕpha and said,
items.kk: And when they came into Kephar Nakum, those who received the tax came to kay-fah and said,

items.name: those who received the tax
items.text: “Does your Teacher not pay the tax?”
items.kk: Does your Teacher not pay the tax?

items.name: shimon
items.text: “Yea.”
items.kk: Yea.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when he came into the house, Yahusha spoke to him first, saying,
items.kk: And when he came into the house, yah-hoo-shah spoke to him first, saying,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What do you think, Shim‛on? From whom do the sovereigns of the earth take toll or tax, from their own sons or from the strangers?”
items.kk: What do you think, sheem-ohn? From whom do the sovereigns of the earth take toll or tax, from their own sons or from the strangers?

items.name: narrator
items.text: Kĕpha then said to Him,
items.kk: kay-fah then said to Him,

items.name: shimon
items.text: “From the strangers.”
items.kk: From the strangers.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Then the sons are exempt.
items.kk: Then the sons are exempt.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast in a hook and take the fish that comes up first. And when you have opened its mouth, you shall find a piece of money. Take that and give it to them for Me and you.”
items.kk: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast in a hook and take the fish that comes up first. And when you have opened its mouth, you shall find a piece of money. Take that and give it to them for Me and you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: At that time the taught ones came to Yahusha, saying,
items.kk: At that time the taught ones came to yah-hoo-shah, saying,

items.name: taught
items.text: “Who, then, is greatest in the reign of the shamayim?”
items.kk: Who, then, is greatest in the reign of the shah-mah-yeem?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha called a little child to Him, set him in their midst,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah called a little child to Him, set him in their midst,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you, unless you turn and become as little children, you shall by no means enter into the reign of the shamayim.
items.kk: Truly, I say to you, unless you turn and become as little children, you shall by no means enter into the reign of the shah-mah-yeem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Whoever then humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the reign of the shamayim.
items.kk: Whoever then humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the reign of the shah-mah-yeem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And whoever receives one little child like this in My Name receives Me.
items.kk: And whoever receives one little child like this in My Name receives Me.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it is better for him that a millstone be hung around his neck and that he be drowned in the depth of the sea.
items.kk: But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it is better for him that a millstone be hung around his neck and that he be drowned in the depth of the sea.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He is not sure why he has been called. He stands there among the grown men in his small robe and waits to be told.
items.kk: He is not sure why he has been called. He stands there among the grown men in his small robe and waits to be told.

items.name: narrator
items.text: They walked the whole road from the mountain arguing it. Now nobody will meet anyone’s eyes.
items.kk: They walked the whole road from the mountain arguing it. Now nobody will meet anyone's eyes.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And it came to be, when the days of His taking up were being completed, He set His face to go to Yahrushalayim,
items.kk: And it came to be, when the days of His taking up were being completed, He set His face to go to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and He sent mal'akim ahead of Him. And they went and entered into a village of the Shomeronites, to prepare for Him.
items.kk: and He sent mahl-ah-keem ahead of Him. And they went and entered into a village of the Shomeronites, to prepare for Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they did not receive Him because His face was set for the journey to Yahrushalayim.
items.kk: And they did not receive Him because His face was set for the journey to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And His taught ones, Ya‛aqoḇ and Yahuchanon, seeing it said,
items.kk: And His taught ones, Yaaqob and yah-hoo-kah-nohn, seeing it said,

items.name: sons
items.text: “Master, do You wish us to command fire to come down from the shamayim and destroy them, as also Aliyahu did?”
items.kk: Master, do You wish us to command fire to come down from the shah-mah-yeem and destroy them, as also ah-lee-yah-hoo did?

items.name: narrator
items.text: But having turned, He rebuked them and said,
items.kk: But having turned, He rebuked them and said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You do not know of what ruach you are, for the Son of Aḏam did not come to destroy men’s lives but to save them.”
items.kk: You do not know of what roo-ahk you are, for the Son of Adam did not come to destroy men's lives but to save them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they went on to another village.
items.kk: And they went on to another village.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And it came to be, as they journeyed on the way, that someone said to Him,
items.kk: And it came to be, as they journeyed on the way, that someone said to Him,

items.name: someone
items.text: “Master, I shall follow You wherever You go.”
items.kk: Master, I shall follow You wherever You go.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “The foxes have holes and the birds of the shamayim nests, but the Son of Aḏam has nowhere to lay His head.”
items.kk: The foxes have holes and the birds of the shah-mah-yeem nests, but the Son of Adam has nowhere to lay His head.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He said to another,
items.kk: And He said to another,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Follow Me,”
items.kk: Follow Me,

items.name: narrator
items.text: but he said,
items.kk: but he said,

items.name: man called to follow
items.text: “Master, let me first go and bury my father.”
items.kk: Master, let me first go and bury my father.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go announce the reign of Aluahim.”
items.kk: Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go announce the reign of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And another also said,
items.kk: And another also said,

items.name: another who would follow
items.text: “Master, I shall follow You but let me first say good-bye to those in my house.”
items.kk: Master, I shall follow You but let me first say good-bye to those in my house.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Yahusha said to him,
items.kk: But yah-hoo-shah said to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “No one, having put his hand to the plough and looking back, is fit for the reign of Aluahim.”
items.kk: No one, having put his hand to the plough and looking back, is fit for the reign of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Galil is behind you, and the lake, and the boats. You turn round again.
items.kk: gah-leel is behind you, and the lake, and the boats. You turn round again.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Sons of thunder. Aliyahu called down fire on this same country once. He would not.
items.kk: Sons of thunder. ah-lee-yah-hoo called down fire on this same country once. He would not.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And it came to be, as He went to Yahrushalayim, that He passed through the midst of Shomeron and Galil.
items.kk: And it came to be, as He went to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem, that He passed through the midst of Shomeron and gah-leel.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as He was entering into a certain village, He was met by ten leprous men, who stood at a distance.
items.kk: And as He was entering into a certain village, He was met by ten leprous men, who stood at a distance.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they lifted up their voices, saying,
items.kk: And they lifted up their voices, saying,

items.name: ten
items.text: “Yahusha, Master, have compassion on us!”
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah, Master, have compassion on us!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having seen them, He said to them,
items.kk: And having seen them, He said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Go, show yourselves to the kohanim.”
items.kk: Go, show yourselves to the koh-hah-neem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And it came to be, that as they were going, they were cleansed.
items.kk: And it came to be, that as they were going, they were cleansed.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, returned, praising Aluahim with a loud voice,
items.kk: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, returned, praising al-oo-ah-heem with a loud voice,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and he fell down upon his face at His feet, giving thanks to Him. And he was a Shomeronite.
items.kk: and he fell down upon his face at His feet, giving thanks to Him. And he was a Shomeronite.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha answering, said,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah answering, said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Were there not ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
items.kk: Were there not ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Was no one found to return to give praise to Aluahim, except this foreigner?”
items.kk: Was no one found to return to give praise to al-oo-ah-heem, except this foreigner?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Rise, go your way. Your belief has made you well.”
items.kk: Rise, go your way. Your belief has made you well.

items.name: narrator
items.text: They are running, shouting to each other, the cloths gone from their faces. They do not look back.
items.kk: They are running, shouting to each other, the cloths gone from their faces. They do not look back.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A Shomeronite, the one the others would not have eaten with. He is the only one of the ten still here.
items.kk: A Shomeronite, the one the others would not have eaten with. He is the only one of the ten still here.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Luke tells this on the long road south, and does not say where on the road it was asked.
items.kk: Luke tells this on the long road south, and does not say where on the road it was asked.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And see, a certain one learned in the Torah stood up, trying Him, saying,
items.kk: And see, a certain one learned in the toh-rah stood up, trying Him, saying,

items.name: learned
items.text: “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit everlasting life?”
items.kk: Teacher, what shall I do to inherit everlasting life?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What has been written in the Torah? How do you read it?”
items.kk: What has been written in the toh-rah? How do you read it?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And he answering, said,
items.kk: And he answering, said,

items.name: learned
items.text: “ ‘You shall love (YAHUAH) HWHY your Aluahim with all your heart and with all your being and with all your strength and with all your mind,’ and ‘your neighbour as yourself.’ ”
items.kk: You shall love YAHUAH your al-oo-ah-heem with all your heart and with all your being and with all your strength and with all your mind, and your neighbour as yourself.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You have answered rightly. Do this and you shall live.”
items.kk: You have answered rightly. Do this and you shall live.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But he, wishing to declare himself righteous, said to Yahusha,
items.kk: But he, wishing to declare himself righteous, said to yah-hoo-shah,

items.name: learned
items.text: “And who is my neighbour?”
items.kk: And who is my neighbour?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And replying, Yahusha said,
items.kk: And replying, yah-hoo-shah said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “A certain man was going down from Yahrushalayim to Yahriḥo and fell among robbers, who, both stripping and beating him, went away, leaving him half dead.
items.kk: A certain man was going down from yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem to Yahriko and fell among robbers, who, both stripping and beating him, went away, leaving him half dead.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And by a coincidence a certain kohen was going down that way. And when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
items.kk: And by a coincidence a certain kohen was going down that way. And when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And likewise a Lĕwite also, when he came to the place and seeing, passed by on the other side.
items.kk: And likewise a Lewite also, when he came to the place and seeing, passed by on the other side.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But a certain Shomeronite, journeying, came upon him and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
items.kk: But a certain Shomeronite, journeying, came upon him and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: and he went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. And having placed him on his own beast, he brought him to an inn and looked after him.
items.kk: and he went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. And having placed him on his own beast, he brought him to an inn and looked after him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And going out on the next day, he took out two pieces of silver, gave them to the innkeeper and said to him, ‘Look after him and whatever more you spend I shall repay you when I return.’
items.kk: And going out on the next day, he took out two pieces of silver, gave them to the innkeeper and said to him, Look after him and whatever more you spend I shall repay you when I return.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Who, then, of these three, do you think, was neighbour to him who fell among the robbers?”
items.kk: Who, then, of these three, do you think, was neighbour to him who fell among the robbers?

items.name: learned
items.text: “He who showed compassion on him.”
items.kk: He who showed compassion on him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Go and do likewise.”
items.kk: Go and do likewise.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Everyone knows that road: steep, bare, and the robbers in the rocks. A man left there would die there.
items.kk: Everyone knows that road, steep, bare, and the robbers in the rocks. A man left there would die there.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A Shomeronite — after a village of them shut its gate on Him. He told it anyway.
items.kk: A Shomeronite, after a village of them shut its gate on Him. He told it anyway.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Luke sets this, too, on the road south without naming the town. To eat with a man was to own him as a friend; the Pharisees would not sit at such a table.
items.kk: Luke sets this, too, on the road south without naming the town. To eat with a man was to own him as a friend, the Pharisees would not sit at such a table.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Now all the tax collectors and the sinners were coming to Him to hear Him.
items.kk: Now all the tax collectors and the sinners were coming to Him to hear Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the Pharisees and scribes grumbled, saying,
items.kk: And the Pharisees and scribes grumbled, saying,

items.name: pharisees
items.text: “This One receives sinners and eats with them.”
items.kk: This One receives sinners and eats with them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He spoke this parable to them, saying,
items.kk: And He spoke this parable to them, saying,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What man among you, having a hundred sheep and having lost one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one which is lost until he finds it?
items.kk: What man among you, having a hundred sheep and having lost one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one which is lost until he finds it?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And having found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
items.kk: And having found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And having come home, he calls together his friends and neighbours, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
items.kk: And having come home, he calls together his friends and neighbours, saying to them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I say to you that in the same way there shall be more joy in the shamayim over one sinner repenting, than over ninety-nine righteous ones who need no repentance.
items.kk: I say to you that in the same way there shall be more joy in the shah-mah-yeem over one sinner repenting, than over ninety-nine righteous ones who need no repentance.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Or what woman, having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and seek diligently til she finds it?
items.kk: Or what woman, having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and seek diligently til she finds it?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And having found it, she calls friends and neighbours together, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin which I lost!’
items.kk: And having found it, she calls friends and neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin which I lost!

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I say to you, in the same way there is joy in the presence of the mal'akim of Aluahim over one sinner repenting.”
items.kk: I say to you, in the same way there is joy in the presence of the mahl-ah-keem of al-oo-ah-heem over one sinner repenting.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “A certain man had two sons,
items.kk: A certain man had two sons,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: and the younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the portion of goods falling to me.’ And he divided his livelihood between them.
items.kk: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods falling to me. And he divided his livelihood between them.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And not many days after, the younger son, having gathered all together, went away to a distant country and there wasted his goods with loose living.
items.kk: And not many days after, the younger son, having gathered all together, went away to a distant country and there wasted his goods with loose living.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And when he had spent all, there arose a severe scarcity of food throughout that land and he began to be in need.
items.kk: And when he had spent all, there arose a severe scarcity of food throughout that land and he began to be in need.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country and he sent him to his fields to feed pigs.
items.kk: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country and he sent him to his fields to feed pigs.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And he was longing to fill his stomach with the pods which the pigs were eating and no one gave to him.
items.kk: And he was longing to fill his stomach with the pods which the pigs were eating and no one gave to him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But having come to himself, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have bread enough and to spare and I am perishing with hunger!
items.kk: But having come to himself, he said, How many of my father's hired servants have bread enough and to spare and I am perishing with hunger!

items.name: narrator
items.text: ‘Having risen, I shall go to my father and say to him,
items.kk: Having risen, I shall go to my father and say to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Father, I have sinned against the shamayim and before you, and I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”
items.kk: Father, I have sinned against the shah-mah-yeem and before you, and I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And having risen, he went to his father. And while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.
items.kk: And having risen, he went to his father. And while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And the son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against the shamayim and before you and I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
items.kk: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against the shah-mah-yeem and before you and I am no longer worthy to be called your son.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
items.kk: But the father said to his servants, Bring out the best robe and put it on him and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: ‘And bring the fattened calf here and slaughter it and let us eat and rejoice,
items.kk: And bring the fattened calf here and slaughter it and let us eat and rejoice,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: because this son of mine was dead and is alive again and he was lost and is found.’ And they began to rejoice.
items.kk: because this son of mine was dead and is alive again and he was lost and is found. And they began to rejoice.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And his older son was in the field and when he came and approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
items.kk: And his older son was in the field and when he came and approached the house, he heard music and dancing.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And having called one of the servants he asked what this meant.
items.kk: And having called one of the servants he asked what this meant.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And he said to him, ‘Your brother has come and your father has slaughtered the fattened calf because he received him back in health.’
items.kk: And he said to him, Your brother has come and your father has slaughtered the fattened calf because he received him back in health.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And he was wroth and would not go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
items.kk: And he was wroth and would not go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And answering, he said to his father, ‘See, these many years I have been serving you and I have never transgressed a command of yours, but to me you have never given a young goat, so I could rejoice with my friends.
items.kk: And answering, he said to his father, See, these many years I have been serving you and I have never transgressed a command of yours, but to me you have never given a young goat, so I could rejoice with my friends.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: ‘But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your livelihood with whores, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him.’
items.kk: But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your livelihood with whores, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Then he said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me and all I have is yours.
items.kk: Then he said to him, Son, you are always with me and all I have is yours.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: ‘And we had to rejoice and be glad, for your brother was dead and is alive and was lost and is found.’ ”
items.kk: And we had to rejoice and be glad, for your brother was dead and is alive and was lost and is found.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He left the story with the older brother standing outside the music, his father pleading. They are standing outside too.
items.kk: He left the story with the older brother standing outside the music, his father pleading. They are standing outside too.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Nobody is eating. A tax collector beside you has his face in his hands.
items.kk: Nobody is eating. A tax collector beside you has his face in his hands.

items.name: narrator
items.text: and went once more to the other side of the Yardĕn to the place where Yahuchanon was immersing at first, and there He stayed.
items.kk: and went once more to the other side of the yar-den to the place where yah-hoo-kah-nohn was immersing at first, and there He stayed.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And many came to Him and said,
items.kk: And many came to Him and said,

items.name: many
items.text: “Yahuchanon indeed did no sign, yet all that Yahuchanon said about this Man was true.”
items.kk: yah-hoo-kah-nohn indeed did no sign, yet all that yah-hoo-kah-nohn said about this Man was true.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And many believed in Him there.
items.kk: And many believed in Him there.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they were bringing little children for Him to touch them, but the taught ones were rebuking those who were bringing them.
items.kk: And they were bringing little children for Him to touch them, but the taught ones were rebuking those who were bringing them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when Yahusha saw it, He was much displeased and said to them,
items.kk: And when yah-hoo-shah saw it, He was much displeased and said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Let the little children come to Me and do not forbid them, for of such is the reign of Aluahim.
items.kk: Let the little children come to Me and do not forbid them, for of such is the reign of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the reign of Aluahim as a little child, shall certainly not enter into it.”
items.kk: Truly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the reign of al-oo-ah-heem as a little child, shall certainly not enter into it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And taking them up in His arms, laying His hands on them, He baruk them.
items.kk: And taking them up in His arms, laying His hands on them, He baruk them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as He was setting out on the way, one came running and knelt before Him and asked Him,
items.kk: And as He was setting out on the way, one came running and knelt before Him and asked Him,

items.name: rich
items.text: “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit everlasting life?”
items.kk: Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit everlasting life?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Why do you call Me good? No one is good except One – Aluahim.
items.kk: Why do you call Me good? No one is good except One, al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You know the commands, ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not bear false witness,’ ‘Do not rob,’ ‘Respect your father and your mother.’ ”
items.kk: You know the commands, Do not commit adultery, Do not murder, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Do not rob, Respect your father and your mother.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And he answering, said to Him,
items.kk: And he answering, said to Him,

items.name: rich
items.text: “Teacher, all these I have watched over from my youth.”
items.kk: Teacher, all these I have watched over from my youth.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha, looking at him, loved him and said to him,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah, looking at him, loved him and said to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “One matter you lack: Go, sell all you possess and give to the poor and you shall have treasure in shamayim. And come, follow Me, taking up the stake.”
items.kk: One matter you lack, Go, sell all you possess and give to the poor and you shall have treasure in shah-mah-yeem. And come, follow Me, taking up the stake.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But he, being sad at this word, went away grieved, for he had many possessions.
items.kk: But he, being sad at this word, went away grieved, for he had many possessions.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha, looking around, said to His taught ones,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah, looking around, said to His taught ones,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the reign of Aluahim!”
items.kk: How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the reign of al-oo-ah-heem!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the taught ones were astonished at His words. And Yahusha responding, said to them again,
items.kk: And the taught ones were astonished at His words. And yah-hoo-shah responding, said to them again,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into the reign of Aluahim!
items.kk: Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into the reign of al-oo-ah-heem!

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “It is easier for a camel to enter through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the reign of Aluahim.”
items.kk: It is easier for a camel to enter through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the reign of al-oo-ah-heem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they were immeasurably astonished, saying among themselves,
items.kk: And they were immeasurably astonished, saying among themselves,

items.name: taught
items.text: “Who then is able to be saved?”
items.kk: Who then is able to be saved?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And looking at them, Yahusha said,
items.kk: And looking at them, yah-hoo-shah said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “With men it is impossible, but not with Aluahim, for with Aluahim all is possible.”
items.kk: With men it is impossible, but not with al-oo-ah-heem, for with al-oo-ah-heem all is possible.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Kĕpha began to say to Him,
items.kk: And kay-fah began to say to Him,

items.name: shimon
items.text: “See, we have left all and we have followed You.”
items.kk: See, we have left all and we have followed You.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for the sake of Me and the Besorah, who shall not receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and lands, with persecutions and in the age to come, everlasting life.
items.kk: Truly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for the sake of Me and the beh-soh-rah, who shall not receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and lands, with persecutions and in the age to come, everlasting life.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But many who are first shall be last, and the last first.”
items.kk: But many who are first shall be last, and the last first.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He walks slowly, as if he were carrying something heavy. “He loved him,” you think. You saw it.
items.kk: He walks slowly, as if he were carrying something heavy. He loved him, you think. You saw it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A house in Bĕyth Leḥem, your father’s scroll, the trade you were taught. A hundredfold, He said — with persecutions.
items.kk: A house in bayt leh-khem, your father's scroll, the trade you were taught. A hundredfold, He said, with persecutions.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they were on the way, going up to Yahrushalayim and Yahusha was going before them. And they were astonished and those who followed were afraid. And again He took the twelve aside and began to say to them what was about to befall Him:
items.kk: And they were on the way, going up to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem and yah-hoo-shah was going before them. And they were astonished and those who followed were afraid. And again He took the twelve aside and began to say to them what was about to befall Him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “See, we are going up to Yahrushalayim and the Son of Aḏam shall be delivered to the chief kohanim and to the scribes and they shall condemn Him to death and shall deliver Him to the gentiles, and they shall mock Him and flog Him and spit on Him and kill Him. And the third day He shall rise again.”
items.kk: See, we are going up to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem and the Son of Adam shall be delivered to the chief koh-hah-neem and to the scribes and they shall condemn Him to death and shall deliver Him to the gentiles, and they shall mock Him and flog Him and spit on Him and kill Him. And the third day He shall rise again.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Ya‛aqoḇ and Yahuchanon, the sons of Zaḇdai, came up to Him, saying,
items.kk: And Yaaqob and yah-hoo-kah-nohn, the sons of Zabdai, came up to Him, saying,

items.name: sons
items.text: “Teacher, we wish that You would do for us whatever we ask.”
items.kk: Teacher, we wish that You would do for us whatever we ask.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What do you wish Me to do for you?”
items.kk: What do you wish Me to do for you?

items.name: sons
items.text: “Grant us to be seated in Your esteem, one on Your right hand and the other on Your left.”
items.kk: Grant us to be seated in Your esteem, one on Your right hand and the other on Your left.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Yahusha said to them,
items.kk: But yah-hoo-shah said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink and be immersed with the immersion that I am immersed with?”
items.kk: You do not know what you ask. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink and be immersed with the immersion that I am immersed with?

items.name: sons
items.text: “We are able.”
items.kk: We are able.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha said to them,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink and with the immersion I am immersed with you shall be immersed, but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared.”
items.kk: You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink and with the immersion I am immersed with you shall be immersed, but to sit on My right hand and on My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when the ten heard it, they began to be sorely displeased with Ya‛aqoḇ and Yahuchanon.
items.kk: And when the ten heard it, they began to be sorely displeased with Yaaqob and yah-hoo-kah-nohn.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha, calling them near, said to them,
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah, calling them near, said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You know that those who think to rule the gentiles are masters over them and their great ones exercise authority over them.
items.kk: You know that those who think to rule the gentiles are masters over them and their great ones exercise authority over them.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “But it is not so among you, but whoever wishes to become great among you shall be your servant.
items.kk: But it is not so among you, but whoever wishes to become great among you shall be your servant.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And whoever wishes to be first among you, shall be servant of all.
items.kk: And whoever wishes to be first among you, shall be servant of all.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For even the Son of Aḏam did not come to be served, but to serve and to give His life a ransom for many.”
items.kk: For even the Son of Adam did not come to be served, but to serve and to give His life a ransom for many.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Above Yahriḥo it goes up into the bare hills, a day’s climb, to Yahrushalayim. He is walking in front, and nobody walks beside Him.
items.kk: Above Yahriko it goes up into the bare hills, a day's climb, to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem. He is walking in front, and nobody walks beside Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A ransom is the price paid to set a captive free. You have heard Him say He will be killed three times now. This is the first time He has said why.
items.kk: A ransom is the price paid to set a captive free. You have heard Him say He will be killed three times now. This is the first time He has said why.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having entered, He was passing through Yahriḥo.
items.kk: And having entered, He was passing through Yahriko.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And see, a man called Zakkai! He was a chief tax collector and he was rich,
items.kk: And see, a man called Zakkai! He was a chief tax collector and he was rich,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and he was seeking to see who Yahusha was, but was unable because of the crowd, for he was small in stature.
items.kk: and he was seeking to see who yah-hoo-shah was, but was unable because of the crowd, for he was small in stature.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having run ahead, he climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him, because He was about to pass by.
items.kk: And having run ahead, he climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him, because He was about to pass by.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as Yahusha came to the place, He looked up and saw him and said to him,
items.kk: And as yah-hoo-shah came to the place, He looked up and saw him and said to him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Zakkai, hurry and come down, for I have to stay at your house today.”
items.kk: Zakkai, hurry and come down, for I have to stay at your house today.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And he hurried and came down and received Him, rejoicing.
items.kk: And he hurried and came down and received Him, rejoicing.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And seeing it, they all grumbled, say ing,
items.kk: And seeing it, they all grumbled, say ing,

items.name: crowd
items.text: “He has gone in to stay with a man who is a sinner.”
items.kk: He has gone in to stay with a man who is a sinner.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Zakkai stood up and said to the Master,
items.kk: But Zakkai stood up and said to the Master,

items.name: zakkai
items.text: “Look, Master, I give half of my possessions to the poor. And if I have taken whatever from anyone by false accusation, I repay fourfold.”
items.kk: Look, Master, I give half of my possessions to the poor. And if I have taken whatever from anyone by false accusation, I repay fourfold.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Today deliverance has come to this house – since he also is a son of Aḇrahim.
items.kk: Today deliverance has come to this house, since he also is a son of Abrahim.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For the Son of Aḏam has come to seek and to save what was lost.”
items.kk: For the Son of Adam has come to seek and to save what was lost.

items.name: narrator
items.text: This morning he was the most hated man in Yahriḥo. He holds the door open for Yahusha as if he were afraid it might close.
items.kk: This morning he was the most hated man in Yahriko. He holds the door open for yah-hoo-shah as if he were afraid it might close.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A sheep, a coin, a son. And now a chief tax collector in a sycamore tree.
items.kk: A sheep, a coin, a son. And now a chief tax collector in a sycamore tree.

items.text: “Yahusha, Son of Dawiḏ, have compassion on me!”
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah, Son of dah-veed, have compassion on me!

items.text: And many were reprimanding him to be silent, but he cried out all the more,

items.name: bartimai
items.text: “Son of Dawiḏ, have compassion on me!”

items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah stopped and said,

items.kk: Rabboni, that I receive my sight.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Go, your belief has healed you.”
items.kk: Go, your belief has healed you.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And immediately he saw again and followed Yahusha on the way.
items.kk: And immediately he saw again and followed yah-hoo-shah on the way.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And having said this, He went on ahead, going up to Yahrushalayim.
items.kk: And having said this, He went on ahead, going up to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And it came to be, when He came near to Bĕyth Phaḡi and Bĕyth Anyah, at the mountain of Olives, that He sent two of His taught ones,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Go into the village opposite you, in which, as you enter, you shall find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Loosen it and bring it here. “And if anyone asks you, ‘Why do you loosen it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Master has need of it.’ ”
items.kk: Go into the village opposite you, in which, as you enter, you shall find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Loosen it and bring it here. And if anyone asks you, Why do you loosen it? thus you shall say to him, Because the Master has need of it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And those who were sent went away and found it as He had said to them.
items.kk: And those who were sent went away and found it as He had said to them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners of it said to them,

items.text: “Why do you loosen the colt?”
items.kk: Why do you loosen the colt?

items.text: “The Master needs it.”
items.kk: The Master needs it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: So they brought it to Yahusha. And throwing their garments on the colt, they set Yahusha on it.
items.kk: So they brought it to yah-hoo-shah. And throwing their garments on the colt, they set yah-hoo-shah on it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And all this took place that it might be filled what was spoken by the naḇi, saying,

items.text: “Say to the daughter of Tsiyon, ‘See, your Sovereign is coming to you, meek and sitting on a donkey, even a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ ”
items.kk: Say to the daughter of Tsiyon, See, your Sovereign is coming to you, meek and sitting on a donkey, even a colt, the foal of a donkey.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as He went, they were spreading their garments on the way.
items.kk: And as He went, they were spreading their garments on the way.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as He was coming near, already at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the entire crowd of the taught ones began, to praise Aluahim, rejoicing with a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen, saying,
items.kk: And as He was coming near, already at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the entire crowd of the taught ones began, to praise al-oo-ah-heem, rejoicing with a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen, saying,

items.name: crowd of the taught ones
items.who: The crowd of the taught ones
items.text: “ ‘Baruk is the Sovereign who is coming in the Name of (YAHUAH) HWHY!’ Shalom in shamayim and esteem in the highest!”
items.kk: Baruk is the Sovereign who is coming in the Name of YAHUAH! shah-lohm in shah-mah-yeem and esteem in the highest!

items.name: narrator
items.text: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd, said to Him,
items.kk: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd, said to Him,

items.text: “Teacher, rebuke Your taught ones.”
items.kk: Teacher, rebuke Your taught ones.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But He answering, said to them,
items.kk: But He answering, said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “I say to you that if these shall be silent, the stones would cry out.”
items.kk: I say to you that if these shall be silent, the stones would cry out.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And as He came near, He saw the city and wept over it,
items.kk: And as He came near, He saw the city and wept over it,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “If you only knew even today, the matters for your shalom! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
items.kk: If you only knew even today, the matters for your shah-lohm! But now they are hidden from your eyes.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Because days shall come upon you when your enemies shall build a rampart around you and surround you and press you on all sides, and dash you to the ground and your children within you. And they shall not leave in you one stone upon another, because you did not know the time of your visitation.”
items.kk: Because days shall come upon you when your enemies shall build a rampart around you and surround you and press you on all sides, and dash you to the ground and your children within you. And they shall not leave in you one stone upon another, because you did not know the time of your visitation.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The whole city at once, across the Qidron: the walls, the roofs, the House of white and gold over them. Everyone around you is singing, and He is weeping.
items.kk: The whole city at once, across the Qidron, the walls, the roofs, the House of white and gold over them. Everyone around you is singing, and He is weeping.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Pilgrims came up to Yahrushalayim from all the land for the Pesach, and the city was full. The road from the Mount of Olives brought Him round to her gates, and the crowds came out to meet Him.
items.kk: Pilgrims came up to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem from all the land for the peh-sahk, and the city was full. The road from the Mount of Olives brought Him round to her gates, and the crowds came out to meet Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And most of the crowd spread their garments on the way, while others cut down branches from the trees and spread them on the way.
items.kk: And most of the crowd spread their garments on the way, while others cut down branches from the trees and spread them on the way.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the crowds who went before and those who followed cried out, saying,
items.kk: And the crowds who went before and those who followed cried out, saying,

items.name: crowds
items.text: “Hoshia-na to the Son of Dawiḏ! Baruk is He who is coming in the Name of (YAHUAH) HWHY! Hoshia-na in the highest!”
items.kk: Hoshia-na to the Son of dah-veed! Baruk is He who is coming in the Name of YAHUAH! Hoshia-na in the highest!

items.name: narrator
items.text: As He entered into Yahrushalayim all the city was saying,
items.kk: As He entered into yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem all the city was saying,

items.name: all
items.text: “Who is this?”
items.kk: Who is this?

items.name: narrator
items.text: The crowds said,
items.kk: The crowds said,

items.name: crowds
items.text: “This is Yahusha, the naḇi from Natsareth of Galil.”
items.kk: This is yah-hoo-shah, the nah-vee from nahts-ah-ret of gah-leel.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahusha went into Yahrushalayim and into the Qodash (Set Apart Place). And having looked around on all, He went out to Bĕyth Anyah with the twelve, as the hour was already late.
items.kk: And yah-hoo-shah went into yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem and into the koh-dahsh. And having looked around on all, He went out to bayt ahn-yah with the twelve, as the hour was already late.

items.name: narrator
items.text: White and gold in the last of the sun, higher than anything men have built in the land. He looked round at all of it, and went out again.
items.kk: White and gold in the last of the sun, higher than anything men have built in the land. He looked round at all of it, and went out again.

items.name: narrator
items.text: They are still singing at the gate. Half of them could not tell you who He is; the other half think they know.
items.kk: They are still singing at the gate. Half of them could not tell you who He is, the other half think they know.

items.name: narrator
items.text: In the great court of the House — the court any nation might enter — the money changers sat at their tables, changing the coins of every land into the silver of the House, and the sellers sat with doves and beasts for the offerings.
items.kk: In the great court of the House, the court any nation might enter, the money changers sat at their tables, changing the coins of every land into the silver of the House, and the sellers sat with doves and beasts for the offerings.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they came to Yahrushalayim. Yahusha, entering into the Qodash (Set Apart Place), began to drive out those who bought and sold in the Qodash (Set Apart Place) and overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those selling doves.
items.kk: And they came to yah-roo-shah-lah-yeem. yah-hoo-shah, entering into the koh-dahsh, began to drive out those who bought and sold in the koh-dahsh and overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those selling doves.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He did not allow anyone to carry a vessel through the Qodash (Set Apart Place).
items.kk: And He did not allow anyone to carry a vessel through the koh-dahsh.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He was teaching, saying to them,
items.kk: And He was teaching, saying to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Has it not been written, ‘My House shall be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it a ‘den of robbers.’ ”
items.kk: Has it not been written, My House shall be called a house of prayer for all nations? But you have made it a den of robbers.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And blind and lame ones came to Him in the Qodash (Set Apart Place) and He healed them.
items.kk: And blind and lame ones came to Him in the koh-dahsh and He healed them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But when the chief kohanim and scribes saw the wonders which He did and the children crying out in the Qodash (Set Apart Place) and saying,
items.kk: But when the chief koh-hah-neem and scribes saw the wonders which He did and the children crying out in the koh-dahsh and saying,

items.name: children
items.text: “Hoshia-na to the Son of Dawiḏ!”
items.kk: Hoshia-na to the Son of dah-veed!

items.name: narrator
items.text: they were greatly displeased,
items.kk: they were greatly displeased,

items.name: chief kohanim and scribes
items.text: “Do You hear what these say?”
items.kk: Do You hear what these say?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Yea, have you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of babes and nurslings You have perfected praise’?”
items.kk: Yea, have you never read, Out of the mouth of babes and nurslings You have perfected praise?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the scribes and the chief kohanim heard it and they were seeking how to destroy Him, for they feared Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching.
items.kk: And the scribes and the chief koh-hah-neem heard it and they were seeking how to destroy Him, for they feared Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A silver piece of Tsor, with a god on it. It is the only coin the House will take. You set it on the step.
items.kk: A silver piece of Tsor, with a god on it. It is the only coin the House will take. You set it on the step.

items.name: narrator
items.text: They have no idea they are quoting a psalm. They are just shouting what everyone shouted at the gate.
items.kk: They have no idea they are quoting a psalm. They are just shouting what everyone shouted at the gate.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they sent to Him some of the Pharisees and the Herodians, to catch Him in a word.
items.kk: And they sent to Him some of the Pharisees and the Herodians, to catch Him in a word.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when they came, they said to Him,
items.kk: And when they came, they said to Him,

items.name: pharisees
items.text: “Teacher, we know that You are true and it does not concern You about anyone, for You are not partial to any, but teach the way of Aluahim in truth. Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
items.kk: Teacher, we know that You are true and it does not concern You about anyone, for You are not partial to any, but teach the way of al-oo-ah-heem in truth. Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

items.name: pharisees
items.text: “Should we pay, or should we not pay?”
items.kk: Should we pay, or should we not pay?

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them,
items.kk: And He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Why do you try Me? Bring Me a silver piece to look at.”
items.kk: Why do you try Me? Bring Me a silver piece to look at.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they brought it and He said to them,
items.kk: And they brought it and He said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Whose likeness and inscription is this?”
items.kk: Whose likeness and inscription is this?

items.name: pharisees
items.text: “Caesar’s.”
items.kk: Caesar's.

items.name: narrator
items.text: So Yahusha said to them,
items.kk: So yah-hoo-shah said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to Aluahim what is Aluahim’s.”
items.kk: Give to Caesar what is Caesar's and to al-oo-ah-heem what is al-oo-ah-heems.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they marvelled at Him.
items.kk: And they marvelled at Him.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And sitting opposite the treasury He saw how the people put copper into the treasury. And many rich ones put in much.
items.kk: And sitting opposite the treasury He saw how the people put copper into the treasury. And many rich ones put in much.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And a poor widow came and threw in two small copper coins, which amount to a cent.
items.kk: And a poor widow came and threw in two small copper coins, which amount to a cent.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And calling near His taught ones He said to them,
items.kk: And calling near His taught ones He said to them,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you that this poor widow has put in more than all those putting into the treasury, for they all put in out of their excess, but she out of her poverty put in all that she had, her entire livelihood.”
items.kk: Truly, I say to you that this poor widow has put in more than all those putting into the treasury, for they all put in out of their excess, but she out of her poverty put in all that she had, her entire livelihood.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Two copper coins. Nobody else in the court saw her. He did.
items.kk: Two copper coins. Nobody else in the court saw her. He did.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Give Caesar his own coin back. And give Aluahim what has His likeness on it.
items.kk: Give Caesar his own coin back. And give al-oo-ah-heem what has His likeness on it.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Now the Pesach and the Festival of Unleavened Bread was after two days. And the chief kohanim and the scribes were seeking how to take Him through treachery and put Him to death.
items.kk: Now the peh-sahk and the Festival of Unleavened Bread was after two days. And the chief koh-hah-neem and the scribes were seeking how to take Him through treachery and put Him to death.

items.name: chief kohanim and scribes
items.text: “Not at the festival, lest there shall be an uproar of the people.”
items.kk: Not at the festival, lest there shall be an uproar of the people.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And while He was in Bĕyth Anyah in the house of Shim‛on the leper and sitting at the table, a woman came having an alabaster flask of perfume, genuine nard, very costly. And breaking the flask she poured it on His head.
items.kk: And while He was in bayt ahn-yah in the house of sheem-ohn the leper and sitting at the table, a woman came having an alabaster flask of perfume, genuine nard, very costly. And breaking the flask she poured it on His head.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But there were some who were much displeased among themselves and said,
items.kk: But there were some who were much displeased among themselves and said,

items.name: some
items.text: “Why was this perfume wasted?
items.kk: Why was this perfume wasted?

items.name: some
items.text: “For it could have been sold for more than three hundred pieces of silver and given to the poor.”
items.kk: For it could have been sold for more than three hundred pieces of silver and given to the poor.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And they were scolding her.
items.kk: And they were scolding her.

items.name: narrator
items.text: But Yahusha said,
items.kk: But yah-hoo-shah said,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for Me.
items.kk: Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for Me.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “For you have the poor with you always and you are able do good to them, whenever you wish. But you do not always have Me.
items.kk: For you have the poor with you always and you are able do good to them, whenever you wish. But you do not always have Me.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “What she had, she used. She took it beforehand to anoint My body for the burial.
items.kk: What she had, she used. She took it beforehand to anoint My body for the burial.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Truly, I say to you, wherever this besorah is proclaimed in all the world, what this woman did shall also be spoken of, to her remembrance.”
items.kk: Truly, I say to you, wherever this beh-soh-rah is proclaimed in all the world, what this woman did shall also be spoken of, to her remembrance.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And Yahuḏah from Qerioth, one of the twelve, went to the chief kohanim to deliver Him up to them.
items.kk: And yah-hoo-dah from Qerioth, one of the twelve, went to the chief koh-hah-neem to deliver Him up to them.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And when they heard it, they were glad and promised to give him silver. And he was seeking how to deliver Him up, conveniently.
items.kk: And when they heard it, they were glad and promised to give him silver. And he was seeking how to deliver Him up, conveniently.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The whole house is full of it. Three hundred pieces of silver, poured out in a moment.
items.kk: The whole house is full of it. Three hundred pieces of silver, poured out in a moment.

items.name: narrator
items.text: He keeps the bag. You never thought twice about him. You do now.
items.kk: He keeps the bag. You never thought twice about him. You do now.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And the Day of Unleavened Bread came when the Pesach had to be slaughtered.
items.kk: And the Day of Unleavened Bread came when the peh-sahk had to be slaughtered.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And He sent Kĕpha and Yahuchanon, saying,
items.kk: And He sent kay-fah and yah-hoo-kah-nohn, saying,

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “Go and prepare the Pesach for us to eat.”
items.kk: Go and prepare the peh-sahk for us to eat.

items.name: two who were sent
items.text: “Where do You wish us to prepare?”
items.kk: Where do You wish us to prepare?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “See, as you enter into the city, a man shall meet you carrying a jar of water. Follow him into the house he enters.
items.kk: See, as you enter into the city, a man shall meet you carrying a jar of water. Follow him into the house he enters.

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And you shall say to the master of the house,‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room where I might eat the Pesach with My taught ones?’
items.kk: And you shall say to the master of the house,The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room where I might eat the peh-sahk with My taught ones?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “And he shall show you a large, furnished upper room. Prepare it there.”
items.kk: And he shall show you a large, furnished upper room. Prepare it there.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And going they found it as He had said to them and they prepared the Pesach.
items.kk: And going they found it as He had said to them and they prepared the peh-sahk.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Cushions about a low table, lamps in the walls, the unleavened bread laid ready. Large enough for thirteen and a few more.
items.kk: Cushions about a low table, lamps in the walls, the unleavened bread laid ready. Large enough for thirteen and a few more.

items.name: narrator
items.text: A man carrying a jar of water — women carry the water. He was there, just as He said.
items.kk: A man carrying a jar of water, women carry the water. He was there, just as He said.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And before the Festival of the Pesach, Yahusha knowing that His hour had come that He should move out of this world unto the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.
items.kk: And before the Festival of the peh-sahk, yah-hoo-shah knowing that His hour had come that He should move out of this world unto the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the end.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And supper taking place, the devil having already put it into the heart of Yahuḏah from Qerioth, son of Shim‛on, to deliver Him up, Yahusha, knowing that the Father had given all into His hands, and that He had come from Aluahim and was going to Aluahim, rose from supper and laid aside His garments, and having taken a towel, He girded Himself.
items.kk: And supper taking place, the devil having already put it into the heart of yah-hoo-dah from Qerioth, son of sheem-ohn, to deliver Him up, yah-hoo-shah, knowing that the Father had given all into His hands, and that He had come from al-oo-ah-heem and was going to al-oo-ah-heem, rose from supper and laid aside His garments, and having taken a towel, He girded Himself.

items.name: narrator
items.text: After that He put water into a basin and began to wash the feet of the taught ones, and to wipe them with the towel with which He was girded.
items.kk: After that He put water into a basin and began to wash the feet of the taught ones, and to wipe them with the towel with which He was girded.

items.name: narrator
items.text: And so He came to Shim‛on Kĕpha, and he said to Him,
items.kk: And so He came to sheem-ohn kay-fah, and he said to Him,

items.text: “Master, do You wash my feet?”
items.kk: Master, do You wash my feet?

items.name: yahusha mashiach
items.text: “You do not know what I am doing now, but you shall know after this.”
items.kk: You do not know what I am doing now, but you shall know after this.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Kĕpha said to Him,
items.kk: kay-fah said to Him,

items.kk: By no means shall You wash my feet, ever!

items.name: narrator
items.text: Yahusha answered him,
items.kk: yah-hoo-shah answered him,

items.name: yahusha mashiach

items.kk: If I do not wash you, you have no part with Me.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Shim‛on Kĕpha said to Him,

items.name: narrator
items.text: and were continually in the Qodash (Set Apart Place) praising and berakah Aluahim! Amĕn.

items.name: narrator
items.text: Ten days of it. You learn the eleven names, and the women's, and His mother's voice when she prays.
items.kk: Ten days of it. You learn the eleven names, and the women's, and His mother's voice when she prays.

items.name: narrator
items.text: The city is filling up for the Festival of Weeks. Pilgrims from every nation under the heavens are coming up the roads.
items.kk: The city is filling up for the Festival of Weeks. Pilgrims from every nation under the heavens are coming up the roads.
